name: Ember Trailers
description: Streams official YouTube trailers through your server with yt-dlp (kept up to date automatically) and builds Ember's Coming Soon calendar from TMDB using the key Jellyfin already has, plus Trakt if you add a key. Nothing is stored.
overview: Official trailers and a release calendar for the Ember app, served by your Jellyfin server.

versions.changelog: Trailers play much more reliably: the server reads YouTube's streams directly and tries several ways (ready-made HD stream, joined picture and sound, plain file, other YouTube player kinds, then yt-dlp) before giving up, starts faster because the title page's check already prepares the stream, and tells Ember exactly why when a trailer can't play. Keeps the HLS stream for Apple TV from 0.5. (Jellyfin 12)
